evolutionary_correction.old: test_no_install_or_enable_script_for_onedrive — asserted no install/enable OneDrive scripts exist in the repository
evolutionary_correction.new: test_connector_runner_has_no_embedded_scheduling — asserts the connector RUNNER has no Register/New/Enable/Start-ScheduledTask
evolutionary_correction.rationale: The old assertion was valid for the connector-only milestone. This milestone intentionally introduced install/enable/audit/remove scripts as a separately gated deployment. The enduring invariant (connector runner stays scheduling-free) is preserved by the new assertion, which is stricter about the right thing.

observations.description: Connector runner has no Register/New/Enable/Start-ScheduledTask, no RepetitionInterval, no New-TimeSpan. Scheduling-free.
Installer: 5-min repetition, 2-min execution limit, IgnoreNew, RunLevel Limited, disabled after install, StartWhenAvailable, Interactive logon, no trading authority, already-exists rejection.

Auditor: read-only (no mutation cmdlets), validates exact identity (name, path, single action+trigger, exe, args, working dir, owner, logon, run level, IgnoreNew, PT2M, PT5M, StartWhenAvailable, runner, Python). action_verified=$true, trading_authority=$false.

Enablement: requires disabled+audited task, fresh LastRunTime>=startedAt, LastTaskResult=0, calls onedrive_delivery_verifier, requires DELIVERY_VERIFIED + verified_count>=1 + trading_authority=false. Catch disables on any failure. Timeout 30-240s default 120.

verify_delivery: every alert has its envelope (matching all fields), receipt (matching schema, delivery_id, sink_id, alert_event_id, envelope_sha256, receipt_id, trading_authority=false). Missing/tampered envelope or receipt rejects. CLI output: state=DELIVERY_VERIFIED, trading_authority=false.

Removal: requires action_verified + trading_authority=false from audit. Disable → Stop → Unregister (safe order). No Remove-Item. EVIDENCE_PRESERVED. No evidence file access (no alerts.jsonl, inbox, receipts).
trading_authority=false in installer ('No trading authority'), auditor ($false), enablement (ne $false check), verifier output (false).
Documentation disclaims authenticated acks, institutional readiness, guaranteed availability. Describes scheduling layer, disable-on-failure, evidence preservation, enablement audit requirement.
